facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Wave and Orange Money payment links suit local CFA clients, not foreign cards.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise at the API-Mali one-stop shop (RCCM and NIF).
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF from the tax administration, issued with your API-Mali registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under FCFA 50m turnover, a 3% synthetic tax, exempt in your first year.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT; synthetic-tax payers under FCFA 50m don't charge it.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 2013-015: declare data processing to the APDP.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Electronic transactions law 2016-012 exists; refund rules not confirmed.
facts.L7_incentives: 3% synthetic tax, with your first calendar year exempt.

watch_out.text: Foreign-currency income from abroad must be surrendered to an approved bank.
